== Notes ==
* In [[PvE]], one may consider using an [[Axe Grip]] [[of the (Profession)|of the Assassin]] to increase the chance for a critical hit.

==Hero Usage==
* Heroes will often activate this skill on recharge, even if the target is not using a skill at that time.
* Heroes will not attempt to increase their critical hit rate prior to using this skill.
* Occasionally heroes will postpone this skill if the target has recently activated a skill (as long as it remains visible in the skill activation window of the target).

== Trivia ==
* The axe illustrated in the [[skill icon]] is a [[Dual Winged Axe]].
* This skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[Critical Chop/Skill history|skill history]] for details.
